we propose a novel model for Bi-LSTMs which is a variant of the LSTM architecture that encourages the two paths to inform each other, and we show that our proposed method performs better than the original Bi-LSTM on a variety of benchmarks.

we introduce Variational Bi-LSTMS, a novel Bi-LSTM architecture that creates a dependence during training between the forward and backward networks, that we evaluate our method on various benchmarks and that our method outperforms other state-of-the-art methods.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a simple yet effective method for training Bi-LSTMs which outperforms existing methods on a number of tasks, and that our model can be applied to any Bi-LSTM-based architecture.
we have proposed a novel model, Variational Bi-LSTMS that is able to improve the performance of Bi-LSTMS.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the forward and backward networks of Bi-LSTMS are not independent and can be made more dependent on each other.
the forward and backward networks of a Bi-LSTM are not independent, but rather are dependent and should inform each other.
